audit.whatIsWrong: Both charts read Sett/Sett/Sett/Skill/Sett/Skill/Skill. The mirror (gragas__sett) settled the lane as Gragas / even / Sett / Sett / even / Sett / even, which disagrees with this page on five of seven rows.
audit.why: Level 1 belongs to Gragas — Barrel Roll reaches 850 and Sett has no gap-closer until Facebreaker at 3, so claiming level 1 for Sett is the page's biggest single error. Level 6 is not a clean Sett row either: Explosive Cask knocks him straight out of the all-in he just started. First item does flip to Sett once Stridebreaker holds Gragas through Body Slam.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 3, 4 and 5 flipped in both layers as one atomic group, ratings moved to match, and every affected why rewritten so no row claims a winner the token disagrees with.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page's spike story was 'strong levels 1-3' with no cooldown behind any of it; the real first spike is level 3 with Haymaker charged.
audit.why: Body Slam is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s — barely moves with rank, so it is punishable all game and it is his only exit. Explosive Cask is 100/85/70s. Facebreaker is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s and Haymaker 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s.
audit.corrected: Body Slam's 13s at rank 3 and 12s at rank 5 keyed to the Levels 4-5 and first-item lines; Explosive Cask's 100s keyed to the level-6 line, which is why that row is no longer a free Sett win.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. (a) Facebreaker was called a pull-stun in every line; Riot makes the stun conditional on enemies being on opposite sides of Sett, so a lone Gragas takes a slow and Body Slams away from it. (b) The spike text told the player to 'Q slow' — Knuckle Down has no slow; it is two empowered punches plus move speed toward enemies.
audit.why: Riot's Sett E text: 'If enemies were only on one side, they are slowed instead of stunned.' Riot's Sett Q text has no slow clause at all. The mirror recorded (a) as the single most important fix in this lane, and both sides now state it identically: you must pull him ACROSS your minions.
audit.corrected: Level-3 phase, the level 3-5 spike and the mid text all now say pull him across the wave so it stuns rather than slows; the phantom Q slow is replaced with Knuckle Down and the centre-true-damage Haymaker cash.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both applicable missing interactions were absent: Happy Hour heals him off ability casts, and Drunken Rage opens his combo with an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Sett's plan is repeated chip; Happy Hour refunds it every time he casts, so without Grievous Wounds the trades never stick. And the reset means the sip animation is the tell — a player watching for the ability cast eats the empowered hit.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal added to the first-item spike; the auto-reset tell added to dontsFull[0].d, replacing a line of pure filler.

notes: Packet conflict the user should resolve: this brief's packet reads 1299 games at 48.19% and a level chart of Sett/Sett/Sett/Sett/Sett/Skill/Skill, while the mirror's packet reported 462 games and a chart the mirror described as Gragas/even/Sett/Sett/even/Sett/even. Two packets describe the same matchup differently. I followed the mirror so the two directions agree, but if the 1299-game packet is the authoritative one, rows 0, 1 and 4 need revisiting on BOTH pages together.
